business_summary: Nanjing Inform Storage Equipment (Group) Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the design, manufacturing, installation, and sale of intelligent warehousing equipment and storage solutions in China and internationally. The company offers smart warehousing solutions, including shuttle + forklift, shuttle + stacker crane, mother-child shuttle, loft-style shuttle, box-type four-way shuttle, box-type two-way shuttle, pallet four-way shuttle, goods-to-person picking, pallet stacker, and box stacker crane systems; and high-precision shelving, such as drive-in and automated warehouse high-level racking, electric mobile and mezzanine shelving, medium-duty type I and II shelving, pallet racking, steel platform, and shuttle, push-back, gravity flow, flow, and cantilever racks. It also provides stacker crane system comprising cheetah, giraffe, bull, and lion stackers, as well as zebra and black panther stacker cranes; shuttle systems, which include four and two-way trays, box-type two and four-way, shuttle mother car, and EMS and flash shuttles; and WMS/WCS, such as iM + library series management system, iC + warehouse series control system, and iN + sound series application system. In addition, the company is involved in supply chain management and related supporting services; technical services; technology development services; trade and investment; and logistics warehousing. Its products are used in car, alcoholic beverages, communication, medicine, energy, food cold chain, and other applications. The company was formerly known as Nanjing Inform Storage Equipment Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Nanjing Inform Storage Equipment (Group) Co., Ltd. in November 2016. Nanjing Inform Storage Equipment (Group) Co., Ltd. was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Nanjing, China.
business_summary_ko: Nanjing Inform Storage Equipment (Group) Co., Ltd.는 자회사와 함께 중국 및 국제적으로 지능형 창고 장비 및 저장 솔루션의 설계, 제조, 설치 및 판매에 참여하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 셔틀 + 지게차, 셔틀 + 스태커 크레인, 모자 셔틀, 로프트 스타일 셔틀, 박스형 4방향 셔틀, 박스형 양방향 셔틀, 팔레트 4방향 셔틀, 상품 대 개인 피킹, 팔레트 스태커 및 박스 스태커 크레인 시스템을 포함한 스마트 창고 솔루션을 제공합니다. 드라이브인 및 자동 창고 고레벨 랙킹, 전기 모바일 및 메자닌 선반, 중형 유형 I 및 II 선반, 팔레트 랙킹, 강철 플랫폼, 셔틀, 푸시백, 중력 흐름, 흐름 및 캔틸레버 랙과 같은 고정밀 선반. 또한 치타, 기린, 황소, 사자 스태커는 물론 얼룩말 및 흑표범 스태커 크레인으로 구성된 스태커 크레인 시스템도 제공합니다. 4방향 및 2방향 트레이, 박스형 2방향 및 4방향, 셔틀 마더카, EMS 및 플래시 셔틀을 포함하는 셔틀 시스템; iM + 라이브러리 시리즈 관리 시스템, iC + 창고 시리즈 제어 시스템, iN + 사운드 시리즈 애플리케이션 시스템 등 WMS/WCS
